head: pc

rounds.note: manual 4th round: rounds 1-2 differed by 512 cells and showed the same free VRAM (allocation granularity), so the step down was taken as 3,072 cells

per_slot_note: the line is on POOL cells: all 4 slots share [0, N); a slot's cells go wherever the allocator puts them, and every slot reads the host tail while the pool's highest used cell is past N (0037 keys the tail draft size on that)
